$comment: Lighthouse CI, MOBILE preset, member shell (SCAN-1138). The sibling of lighthouserc.json, which keeps
gating the four anonymous marketing pages on the desktop preset.
WHY A SECOND FILE. Only four anonymous marketing URLs on the desktop preset were measured, and nothing
asserted JavaScript size, so the member shell (components/layout/app-shell.tsx and everything
statically reachable from it, parsed on every phone on every app/(main) route) was unmeasured. One
lighthouse-ci config carries one preset, so mobile needs its own file.
WHAT IS MEASURED. `/` is the marketing home on a phone. `/feed` signed out renders the REAL member
shell with the viewer drawn as Anonymous (lib/nav/anon-feed.ts, SCAN-889), so it needs no session and
is the cheapest honest reading of the shell's script weight.
EVERY ASSERTION IS A WARN, ON PURPOSE, FOR NOW. Nobody has a mobile lab reading for this site, and the
first thresholds on a new instrument are guesses (ADR-930 said so about the desktop ones and was
right). The `Report the numbers` step in .github/workflows/e2e.yml prints the medians and the script
weight into the job summary on every run. After a few runs, set each number from that data and move
LCP, TBT and the script size to `error`, the way lighthouserc.json did in ADR-936.
SCRIPT SIZE. `resource-summary:script:size` is the bytes of JavaScript the page loads. 600000 is a
provisional line (about 600 KB over the wire is where a mid-range phone starts to feel parse time),
chosen to warn loudly rather than to be right.
Same caveats as lighthouserc.json: a LAB run on a shared runner against a cold preview, three runs
and the median, INP absent because it needs a real interaction.
